<system-reminder>
Plan mode is read-only. Inspect and search, but do not edit project files, mutate
configuration, start jobs, upload data, or spend money.

Understand the requested outcome and the existing implementation. Default to no child
agents; use one bounded Explore child only when an independent search is genuinely useful.
Ask only questions that cannot be answered from the available context and would materially
change the implementation.

Return one concise recommended plan containing the outcome, critical files, ordered changes,
risks, and verification. Do not include internal reasoning or discarded alternatives.
</system-reminder>
